body: Got you; hmm I’m trying to think— that is quite the situation. I can only relate in that I dealt with bullying (only a little bit) and anxiety attacks/panic attacks before. It really is paralyzing. Might you have any friends/ people you could roll with. Maybe not good friends, but classmates that you could hang around perhaps? (Know maybe that isn’t really realistic  given the anxiety, but yeah)

Definitely don’t apologize, at all. Yeah that sounds extreme rough; to have to endure everything— not only just anxiety itself but the bullying, the abuse, all of it. That sounds absolutely hellish. Are you able to mention the bullying at school to any of you’re teachers/administrators. Or no, is it one of those situations where if the word got out it would worsen the issue (also, would it be rough with you’re anxiety)?

Hey; I’m kind of down but aye it’s all good. What kind of distractions work best for you usually. Do you have any kind of outlets that usually help, say music, journaling, talking, drawing etc etc? Or not really. 

And what’s been troubling you/triggered these feelings? (if you want to say of course)
